intro.h2: Kitchen Remodeling Without the Long Wait
paragraphs: Ortega Remodeling handles kitchen remodeling from cabinets to countertops, and its customers keep mentioning speed. One customer was skeptical about a large project on a short timeline, yet Fernando Ortega and his team remodeled the kitchen in two weeks flat, at a very reasonable price compared with other estimates.

Brenda J. says the team was patient while she picked her countertop, then installed it in one day. Denise M. has had almost a whole house done: new flooring, interior painting, a kitchen makeover, an upgraded bathroom and a full room addition. And the two-week kitchen customer is already planning a room conversion with the same team.

about.h2: Meet Fernando Ortega and the Team
about.text: Ortega Remodeling is led by Fernando Ortega, and the logo carries the full company name, Ortega Remodeling and Services Inc. The team takes on kitchens, bathrooms, countertops, flooring, interior painting and room additions, and posts its projects on Instagram. Customers describe the crew as friendly, dependable and committed to quality work, and say every project was handled with care and professionalism. One family whose kitchen was finished in two weeks is already getting ready for its next project with the team, a room conversion.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with marble-look tile, a jetted tub under a shuttered bay window and a glass shower panel

process.h2: How a Remodel With Ortega Works

steps.title: Call
steps.text: Call (562) 618-3424 Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM or Saturday 9 AM to 2 PM to describe your project.

steps.title: Estimate
steps.text: The team looks at the space and gives you an estimate. Reviewers found the price reasonable compared with other estimates.

steps.title: Choose materials
steps.text: Pick cabinets, counters, tile and flooring at your own pace. The team stays patient while you decide, as a reviewer noted.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The team gets to work. Reviewers describe a countertop installed in one day and a full kitchen remodeled in two weeks flat.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Fernando and the team go over the finished space with you, room by room, and sort out any last details.

service_area.text: Ortega Remodeling has not published a street address or a list of service towns on Google, so the quickest way to check is to call (562) 618-3424 and give your address. The team is open Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 9 AM to 2 PM. Tell them about the room you want to change and when you hope to start.

items.q: How long does a kitchen remodel take?
items.a: Kitchen size and material choices set the schedule. As one example, a reviewer had her kitchen remodeled in two weeks flat and said the team delivered as promised. Countertop installation alone was done in one day for another customer. Ask about the timeline for your own kitchen when you get your estimate.

Kitchen remodeling, countertop installation, bathroom remodeling, new flooring, interior painting, room additions and room conversions. Reviewers have had everything from a single countertop to a home transformed from top to bottom. Something different in mind? Describe it on the phone and the team will say whether it is a fit.

items.q: Can you help me choose a countertop?
items.a: Yes. One customer says the team was patient with her while she picked her countertop, and the installation was done in one day. Bring photos of styles you like, and ask about colors and edge profiles when the team comes out to look at your kitchen.

Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 6 PM, and Saturday from 9 AM to 2 PM. They are closed on Sunday. Call (562) 618-3424 during those hours, or leave a voicemail with your name, your number and a short description of the job.

Prices depend on the project and are not published, but one reviewer who collected several estimates says Ortega Remodeling came in at a very reasonable price compared with the others, and still finished a large kitchen on a short timeline. Ask for a written estimate to compare.

final_cta.text: Call Fernando and the team about your kitchen remodeling, bathroom or room addition.
